title: Add docstrings and doctests to non-obvious code
description:
Judiciously add docstrings and doctests to functions and structs where behavior is not obvious from the signature. Focus on:
- Validation logic (can_be_part_of_epic, add_relationship)
- Filename generation (file_name, short_code)
- ID resolution and manipulation (short_id)
- Index operations that have side effects
- Complex FromStr implementations with multiple aliases

Follow Rust documentation standards with /// and include doctests for key examples.
